name: cryptogram
description: Printable cryptogram puzzles from your quotes, with an answer key.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable cryptogram puzzles with answers from your own quotes, for a class, a club newsletter, a puzzle night or a grandparent who loves cryptoquotes. Zovo Cryptogram Maker is a cryptogram maker that turns each quote and author into a letter substitution puzzle and gives you a PDF with an answer key.

Each puzzle gets its own letter key, shuffled at random from a seed rather than taken from keyboard order. No letter stands for itself, and each cipher letter stands for one plain letter only, so the puzzle has a clean answer. Each key is checked before the PDF is made, and the same seed reprints the same puzzles.

Choose easy (3 hint letters filled in), medium (1 hint) or hard (no hints), or set the number of hints yourself. A letter count grid under each puzzle helps solvers start with the common letters. Large print uses bigger letters and boxes for seniors and anyone with low vision. The author line can be part of the puzzle, as in a newspaper cryptoquote, or printed plainly. Up to 30 puzzles fit in one PDF on Letter or A4, and the answer key pages list each quote with its letter key.

Only the letters A to Z are enciphered. Accented letters such as é, ł and ü and letters from other alphabets are printed as written, and the result tells you when that happens.

Stuck on a cryptoquote? The solver answers in seconds. It ranks possible readings against an English word list of about 25,000 words, shows the letter key, the letters still open and up to 2 alternatives, and says whether its confidence is high, medium or low. Give it a known letter from the printed clue to narrow it down.

Limitations: letter ciphers only (no symbol or number ciphers), the solver reads English only, uses word frequency without grammar, and is often unsure or wrong about short texts, names, pangrams and sentences made of rare words (it then says its confidence is low), and the PDF prints Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out).
defaultPrompt: Make cryptogram puzzles from: The only way to do great work is to love what you do - Steve Jobs
Make 3 large print cryptograms for my grandmother with 2 hints each
Help me solve this cryptoquote: GSV YVHG GRNV GL KOZMG Z GIVV DZH GDVMGB BVZIH ZTL

positive.prompt: Make cryptograms for my class, 2 hints each, seed 2026: The only way to do great work is to love what you do (Steve Jobs); In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity (Albert Einstein)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cryptograms once with 2 objects in puzzles and hints 2. The reply shows 2 enciphered quotes with the author names enciphered too, says no letter stands for itself, and gives a PDF link with the puzzles and an answer key page.

positive.prompt: Large print cryptograms, easy, seed 77: Do not count the days, make the days count (Muhammad Ali); A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step (Lao Tzu)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cryptograms once with large_print true and difficulty easy. The reply says 2 cryptograms with 3 hint letters each in large print and gives the PDF link; the PDF uses big letters and boxes and ends with the answer key.

positive.prompt: Help me solve this cryptoquote: GSV YVHG GRNV GL KOZMG Z GIVV DZH GDVMGB BVZIH ZTL. GSV HVXLMW YVHG GRNV RH MLD.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls solve_cryptogram once with the ciphertext. The reply gives the reading THE BEST TIME TO PLANT A TREE WAS TWENTY YEARS AGO. THE SECOND BEST TIME IS NOW. with high confidence (17 of 17 words recognised) and the letter key.

positive.prompt: My puzzle book clue says X = B. What is XMNM?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls solve_cryptogram once with ciphertext XMNM and known letter X=B. The reply gives a candidate reading but says the confidence is low because a single short word has many readings, and asks for more of the puzzle.

positive.prompt:
Make hard cryptograms on A4 without letter counts, seed 5:
Be yourself; everyone else is already taken. - Oscar Wilde
Café crème déjà vu à Łódź über alles - Zoë
123 456
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_cryptograms once. The reply makes 2 puzzles with no hints, skips the line with only digits because it has no letters, and says the accented letters are printed as written and not enciphered. The A4 PDF has an answer key.

negative.description: Symbol ciphers are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains this plugin makes letter cryptograms only.
negative.prompt: Make me a pigpen cipher with symbols for a treasure hunt

negative.description: Today's newspaper answer without the puzzle text is not something it can look up. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant asks for the puzzle text or answers without this plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the cryptoquote answer today in the newspaper?

negative.description: Encryption for real secrets is not this job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant does not offer a cryptogram as security.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: cryptogram puzzles from your quotes with hints, letter counts, large print and an answer key, plus a cryptoquote helper that states its confidence.

pl-PL.subtitle: Kryptogramy do druku
pl-PL.description: Kryptogramy do wydruku z Twoich cytatów, z kluczem odpowiedzi. Każda zagadka ma własny klucz: żadna litera nie oznacza samej siebie, a każda litera szyfru oznacza tylko jedną literę. Podpowiedzi, tabela liczby liter i duży druk dla seniorów. Szyfrowane są tylko litery A do Z, litery z akcentami zostają bez zmian. Pomocnik do rozwiązywania kryptocytatów po angielsku podaje możliwe odczytania i mówi, na ile jest pewny.

de-DE.subtitle: Kryptogramme zum Ausdrucken
de-DE.description: Kryptogramme zum Ausdrucken aus Ihren eigenen Zitaten, mit Lösungsseite. Jedes Rätsel hat einen eigenen Schlüssel: Kein Buchstabe steht für sich selbst, und jeder Geheimbuchstabe steht für genau einen Buchstaben. Hinweisbuchstaben, Buchstabenzählung und Großdruck für Senioren. Verschlüsselt werden nur A bis Z, Umlaute und Akzente bleiben wie geschrieben. Ein Lösungshelfer für englische Kryptozitate nennt mögliche Lesarten und sagt, wie sicher er ist.

es-ES.subtitle: Criptogramas para imprimir
es-ES.description: Criptogramas para imprimir a partir de tus propias frases, con solucionario. Cada acertijo tiene su propia clave: ninguna letra se representa a sí misma y cada letra cifrada equivale a una sola letra. Letras de pista, tabla de frecuencias y letra grande para personas mayores. Solo se cifran las letras de la A a la Z; las letras con acento quedan como están. Un ayudante para criptocitas en inglés propone lecturas e indica su nivel de confianza.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cryptogrammes à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Cryptogrammes à imprimer à partir de vos propres citations, avec corrigé. Chaque grille a sa propre clé : aucune lettre ne se code par elle-même et chaque lettre codée correspond à une seule lettre. Lettres indices, tableau des fréquences et gros caractères pour les seniors. Seules les lettres A à Z sont chiffrées ; les lettres accentuées restent telles quelles. Un assistant pour les cryptocitations en anglais propose des lectures et indique son degré de confiance.

ja-JP.subtitle: 印刷用の暗号パズル
ja-JP.description: 好きな名言から印刷用の暗号パズル（クリプトグラム）を答え付きで作ります。パズルごとに別の換字表を使い、同じ文字に置き換わる文字はなく、暗号の1文字は元の1文字だけに対応します。ヒント文字、文字数の表、シニア向けの大きな文字も選べます。暗号化するのはAからZだけで、アクセント付きの文字はそのまま印刷します。英語のクリプトクオートの解読ヘルパーは候補と確信度を示します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Criptogramas para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Criptogramas para imprimir a partir das suas próprias frases, com gabarito. Cada enigma tem sua própria chave: nenhuma letra representa a si mesma e cada letra cifrada equivale a uma única letra. Letras de dica, tabela de contagem de letras e letra grande para idosos. Só as letras de A a Z são cifradas; letras com acento ficam como estão. Um ajudante para criptocitações em inglês sugere leituras e informa o nível de confiança.
